the guest reached Ready with userspace SELinux detection restored
selinux_runtime.assessment: Confirms the intended split: userspace labeling remains active while enforcement is permissive.

evidence: vendor.drm-widevine-hal-1-3 started as pid 2795 and remained running
the legacy plugin reported ERROR_DRM_CANNOT_HANDLE for the Android 16 provisioningModel property

code_review.finding: A13 and the current target use the same V1_2 plugin behind a V1_3 factory and pass string properties to the legacy blob. Android 16 RKP treats only BootCertificateChain as Provisioning 4.0 and catches all other property failures as no provisioning work. The V1_0-to-V1_4 cast warning is emitted by diagnostic log collection, not plugin creation.
code_review.decision: Do not invent a V1_4 plugin or synthesize provisioningModel. Playback/decryption remains a separate functional oracle.

audio_host_contract.limitation: No playback, capture, or route-change test was run.

netbpf.evidence: NetBpfLoad initialized the netd BPF maps and the boot remained Ready.

adb_guest_shell.evidence: 127.0.0.1:5555 remained without a listener and HD-Adb reported offline even during a temporary host-only bst.enable_adb_access=1 trial.
adb_guest_shell.cleanup: bst.enable_adb_access was restored to 0 and all processes started for the trial were stopped.
